facts.fact: The open-air museum is at MountYashima’s foot and has33restored historic buildings relocated from four Shikoku prefectures.
facts.excerpt: 33 restored historic buildings relocated here from the four prefectures of Shikoku

facts.fact: The buildings date1603–1926 and had actual residential, workshop, storage and community uses.
facts.excerpt: All were built during a period ranging from 1603 to 1926

facts.fact: The contemporary gallery was designed by TadaoAndo; the guide does not promise a particular exhibition.
facts.excerpt: Shikoku Mura Gallery, designed by Tadao Ando
